course_enrollments.name: course_enrollments
course_enrollments.body_sql:
SELECT 
  `COURSE_NUMBER` AS `course`,
  `SECTION_ID` AS `section`,
  SUM(`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`) AS `enrolled_students`
FROM `subject_offered`
GROUP BY `COURSE_NUMBER`, `SECTION_ID`

building_details.name: building_details
building_details.description: building key and corresponding building name

top_building.name: top_building
top_building.body_sql:
SELECT 
  `BUILDING_NAME` AS `building_name`,
  `ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS `accommodation_capacity`
FROM `fac_building`
ORDER BY `accommodation_capacity` DESC
top_building.description: ranks buildings by accommodation capacity descending

buildings.name: buildings
buildings.body_sql:
SELECT 
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS name,
  f.FLOOR AS floor,
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY
FROM buildings b
JOIN fac_floor f ON b.BUILDING_KEY = f.BUILDING_KEY
buildings.description: all buildings with their name and floor number

session_cohort_metrics.name: session_cohort_metrics
session_cohort_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(iap_subject_detail.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(iap_subject_detail.FEE) AS total_fees,
  MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, iap_subject_session.SESSION_START_TIME, iap_subject_session.SESSION_END_TIME)) AS min_duration,
  MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, iap_subject_session.SESSION_START_TIME, iap_subject_session.SESSION_END_TIME)) AS max_duration
FROM iap_subject_session
JOIN iap_subject_detail ON iap_subject_session.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iap_subject_detail.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
session_cohort_metrics.description: aggregated measures over the filtered session cohort, yielding total subject count, total fees, and min/max duration

course_details.name: course_details
course_details.body_sql:
SELECT 
    scd.COURSE,
    sd.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name,
    scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
    scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS is_degree_granting,
    scd.DEPARTMENT,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
FROM sis_course_description scd
JOIN sis_department sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
course_details.description: join course records with school and department reference tables to include school name, department full name, course level, and a degree-granting indicator

term_course_aggregates.name: term_course_aggregates
term_course_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
  c.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  c.HGN_CODE AS hgn_code,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  e.FULL_NAME AS person_in_charge_name,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS person_in_charge_email,
  c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS responsible_faculty_mit_id,
  e.MIT_ID AS mit_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_course_types,
  AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_units
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
GROUP BY
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  c.HGN_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  e.FULL_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  e.MIT_ID
term_course_aggregates.description: Groups the course details by academic year, term code, hgn code, department, and person in charge to compute the total distinct course types and average units per group.

term_metadata.name: term_metadata
term_metadata.description: projects the academic term identifier, full descriptive name, and a boolean flag indicating current status

building_room_metrics.name: building_room_metrics
building_room_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT
  f.BUILDING_KEY AS building_id,
  MAX(f.FLOOR) AS highest_floor,
  MIN(f.FLOOR) AS lowest_floor,
  COUNT(f.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms
FROM fac_rooms f
GROUP BY f.BUILDING_KEY
building_room_metrics.description: aggregates floor numbers and room counts per building
